verdict.rationale: Authy documents automatic multi-device sync across phone and tablet (and Apple Watch), and community users confirm multi-device support is why they chose it. The computer leg of the story is contradicted, though: docs list macOS, Windows and Linux apps, but community reports say the desktop apps were EOL'd with near-immediate deprecation. missing for 10: working desktop/computer availability for simultaneous sync, independent hands-on confirmation of how automatic the sync is.
